verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM ships versioned releases with dated per-version changelogs (v1.6.0 through v1.19.0) that match its GitHub releases, so the 'versioned releases with changelogs' part of the story is documented. Nothing in the evidence covers migration notes for self-hosted upgrades or any repair or rollback procedure when an update breaks. Missing for 10: documented migration/upgrade notes, a repair or rollback path for failed updates, a backwards-compatibility policy, and independent hands-on corroboration of safe upgrades.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, updating is safe and documented — versioned releases with changelogs, migration notes, and a repair or rollback path when an update breaks

citations.quote: the vendor maintains dated per-version changelogs (v1.6.0 through v1.19.0 in the docs nav, matching GitHub releases)
